verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's Entity Management API returns entity data in open JSON or CSV formats, up to 1,000,000 records. It also offers an API Extract for bulk retrieval, and registered users can pull data up to the sensitivity level of their account, including FOUO and Sensitive tiers. However, this is a general data-access API rather than a documented personal-data export, and it requires an API key or an approved System Account. missing for 10: a documented 'export all my account data' feature covering registrations, workspace items and saved searches; an account-closure or leave workflow; independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
